Features
A multi-purpose table, a space-saving wonder: 100 x 50 cm compact size, fits easily into small apartments; perfect for dining together, ideal for gatherings and meals!

Hydraulic lift + double table design: Exclusive double hydraulic lift system, the table height can be adjusted continuously, and you can switch between office, dining, and leisure with the touch of a button. The extendable large table allows you to change the setting as desired.

Super strong load-bearing capacity, stabilization, and durability: Made of carefully selected high-density particleboard, the total load-bearing capacity is up to 50 kg. When unfolded, it is stable and does not wobble.

Master of hidden storage: Four storage stools are hidden inside the table and can be removed when needed. A large storage unit can be transformed, so you don't have to worry about keeping your belongings hidden!

Smart pulley system + silent drawer: 4-wheel design (2 with brakes), ultra-flexible movement and locking mechanism;

The coffee table transforms into an office desk in a snap: The sleek white look is complemented by multi-level height adjustment, allowing you to work efficiently and with focus during the day and lower the tabletop in the evening to create a cozy coffee nook. One table can meet all your needs throughout the day.

Open storage space at the back: Snacks, magazines, router—everything has its place! Nothing is cluttered anymore.

A storage savior for small apartments: The stool, tabletop, and casters can be hidden when not in use and retracted to a compact 100 x 50 cm. Creates a great atmosphere!

Easily switch between multifunctional settings: Suitable for home offices, living rooms, balconies, and dorm rooms – the desk can be transformed into a work table, dining table, game table, and storage unit, allowing you to improve both your efficiency and style!

NOTE: This product comes in two packages and may not arrive at the same time. Please ensure both packages have arrived before beginning assembly!
